title: SampleBatchMessage
description: Runtime to the motion client: device samples in sequence order, each sent once (SPEC.md section 8). One sample is the device sample of device protocol v1, section 7.2.

seq_source.description: device: seq is the device's own number, so a gap is a counted loss. host: the runtime numbered the samples as they arrived (legacy-v0.3), so a gap can only be inferred from the device clock.

t_dev_us.description: End of the sample's window on the unwrapped device clock (device protocol v1, H6), or the runtime's clock at receipt when the device has none.

dt_us.description: The time d covers: t_dev_us minus the previous sample's, so longer than one period after a gap.

d.description: Body-frame displacement [forward cm, left cm, dyaw rad] = C * raw, with the rig file's calibration C; yaw positive counter-clockwise seen from above.

raw.description: Counts per sensor axis since the previous sample, before calibration.

flags.description: Bits 0-7: the device's flags byte, unchanged (bit 0 count_incomplete, bit 1 no_tracking). Bit 8 (256): dt_estimated, dt_us is an estimate, not a measured window: for a stream's first sample, the declared period, or (seq + 1) times it when the first seq is above 0 (device protocol v1, section 7.2). Bit 9 (512): dt_mismatch, the device's window length disagreed with its clock (device protocol v1, H6). Bits 10-15: reserved, 0.

gap.description: Samples lost just before this one (counted or inferred): 0 when none.
